description: This file defines the 'Platform' class in the org.apache.spark.unsafe package, providing low-level memory access and manipulation utilities using sun.misc.Unsafe, including methods for memory allocation, deallocation, copying, and direct ByteBuffer allocation, with reflection-based access to internal JVM classes.

classes.name: Platform
classes.description: A utility class providing low-level memory operations and direct ByteBuffer allocation using sun.misc.Unsafe, with reflection-based access to internal JVM classes and methods.

methods.name: cleanerCreateMethodIsDefined
